name: Supersaw Swarm Styles
author: Freek van Gool
description: Supersaw tunes for Supersaw Swarm in trance, hardstyle, progressive, big room, synthwave, pop, future bass, eurodance, ambient and cinematic styles: leads, chords, pads, plucks, basses and textures. Tunes that use the trance gate or the pump only move with a running clock; they are also usable without one. Also has Dancefloor DnB, Liquid DnB, Neuro DnB and Jungle folders: rave stabs, wide supersaw leads, liquid pads and chords, dark neuro pads and dub stabs.
